0022600148.text: The 76ers (5-1, 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East) are on a two-game winning streak as they visit the Hornets (3-3, 3rd in the Southeast and 8th in the East), who have lost their last two. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti, Dominick Barlow, Jabari Walker, Joel Embiid, LeBron James, and Tacko Fall, and Jaylen Brown is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision. Charlotte is without Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel, and Kylan Boswell, and the teams have not yet met in the 2026-27 season, though the 76ers won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 118-114 win in Charlotte on March 28, 2026.
